diagnosis: One job (ab-f004240385903168d9925de1 / 创建卡片, attempted twice) had both Native Workers hit the 420 s Worker timeout, so those sides had no readable output and no call signals; the Federated side completed with 11/12 calls erroring. The executor correctly recorded the job unknown/worker_timeout. Across 1,290 dispatched jobs this was the only non-passed Worker run, and no passed Worker run lacked call signals.
classification: gate_rule_too_strict; no harness or data defect
fix: Gate counts missing call signals as an anomaly only when that side's Worker exited normally; timed-out or failed Worker runs count toward a new worker_not_passed rate (limit 10%).
batch_rerun: Not required: the batch's queue results are correct as recorded (terminal rows are never rewritten).
